title: Oil Rich Ukrainian Pork Borscht
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian dish featuring pork, vegetables, and a rich broth, perfect for a hangover cure. This dairy-free friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the onions until they are translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the beets, carrots, ferment-jang, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the boiling water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the pork is tender.
Serve the borscht hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Let the borscht cool, then refrigerate or freeze for later use.
Reheat the borscht over low heat, adding more water if needed, until warmed through.
